simple.summary: יׇקְנְעָם (Yoqnᵉʻâm) means Jokneam , a place in Palestine First listed occurrence: Josh 12 22.

definitions.full: H3362. Yoqneam יָקְנְעָם proper name, of a location Canaanitish city , with a king, defined by לַכַּרְמֶל Josh 12:22 ; in Zebulun 19:11 ; Levitical city 21:34 .
definitions.rootNote: from 6969 and 5971 ; (the) people will be lamented;
